headline: Sensex and Nifty decline as crude oil prices and geopolitical tensions weigh on market sentiment

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: Rising crude oil prices and geopolitical risks in the Middle East
Significant FPI outflows impacting domestic market liquidity
Concerns regarding US Fed policy and weak cues from Asian markets
Selling pressure in IT and PSU bank stocks dragging the indices
whatHappening: Sensex fell over 500 points while Nifty 50 slipped below the 22,450 level
AU Small Finance Bank shares tumbled 10% following its Q2 earnings report
Kotak Mahindra Bank shares rallied over 3% after reporting a strong Q2 beat
Shriram Finance shares crashed 6% as brokerages slashed target prices despite 'Buy' ratings
summary: The Indian stock market faced a sharp decline today with the Sensex dropping over 500 points due to high oil prices and global geopolitical tensions. While Kotak Mahindra Bank and Sun Pharma saw gains, financial stocks like AU Small Finance Bank and Shriram Finance experienced significant sell-offs. Investors remain cautious as FPI outflows and US Fed policy concerns continue to weigh on the indices.
